description:
List integrations where the named service is either the source or destination. The result includes IDs, both sides of the integration, service types, status, and user_config so an existing integration can be inspected or selected for update or deletion.

An `application_service_credential` integration is created at the project level, not on either service. Set PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, Valkey, Kafka, or OpenSearch as `source_service` and the application service as `dest_service`. The integration appears when listing integrations for either service. `user_config.exposed_values` contains `environment_variable_key` configuration, not the values injected into the application service.

The MCP schema currently describes `application_service_credential` in detail. Aiven supports other integration types too.


This tool may return a long list; results support filtering and pagination to narrow large catalogs.

limit.description: Max items to return. Do NOT set this unless the user explicitly asked for a specific number of results.

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Use the value from the `next_offset` field in a previous response to fetch the next page.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter. Matches against `integration_type`, `source_service`, `dest_service`. Only items containing this string are returned.

name: aiven_service_integration_list
title: Service Integration List
